about_the_game:
Chaos Classroom is a fast-paced action roguelite and bullet heaven adventure that takes place in the imagination of a group of students. Players will navigate through reimagined school settings—gymnasiums into castles, math class into a witch's paradise, and science class into a lab for variety of slimy experiments. All of these teeming with a variety of make-believe monsters.

Team up with a dynamic cast of students, each bringing their unique abilities, personalities, and playstyles into the fray. Swap seamlessly between characters to strategize, exploit enemy weaknesses, or adapt to the challenges the imaginative school world throws your way.

Survive escalating waves of whimsical foes and collect powerful upgrades as you strive to make it through the chaotic week. Will you master the creativity-fueled chaos and emerge victorious, or will the classroom get the better of you and end up in detention? Jump into the action and let your imagination run wild!
